name: reactor-mode-4f-battle-command-right
description: #110 attempt 1: command cursor and targeting in the first guard battle (Cloud alone, slot 0). From "battle": wait until the widget id reads 1, the command menu (open_wait; while the ATB gauge fills); the menu slot must read 0 within a frame (actor_wait 1). 30 frames with no input. The cursor row of slot 0 must read 0 within a frame (a timeout fails); Down every 20 frames (held 4) until it reads 1 (down_wait), then Up the same way until it reads 0 (up_wait). Circle every 30 frames (held 4) on Attack until the widget id reads 0, target selection (target_wait; the wait stops at the first frame it does, so no second Circle confirms the attack). 20 frames with no input, mark "target", then Right held 4 frames and 20 frames with no input: the two candidate target bytes, compared with the mark (t7_dir, t9_dir, signs only; a check fails unless it changed). The widget must still read 0 (still targeting). match: a rerun from the same snapshot.
